data.one_liner: A powerful and extensible Liquid template engine for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Parses, renders, and extends Liquid templates in Dart and Flutter applications. Supports synchronous and asynchronous rendering, custom delimiters, environment-scoped filters, and template inheritance.
use_when: You need to render Liquid templates within Dart or Flutter applications.
You want custom delimiters or sandboxed template execution.
avoid_when: You do not need dynamic template rendering or the Liquid syntax.
strengths: Full support for standard Liquid syntax and semantics
Extensible architecture for custom tags and filters
High-performance parsing with caching and browser support
weaknesses: Requires learning Liquid template language syntax if unfamiliar
